sheets.name: GSC-GA4 Insights
rows: http:// and https:// homepage indexed as two separate URLs
GSC: https://shumakerroofing.com/ = 23,786 impr / pos 5.6; http://shumakerroofing.com/ = 4,766 impr / pos 1.6 (outranking the https version). Signals a broken/inconsistent http->https redirect.

Verify next.config.mjs / hosting-level redirect forces a single 301/308 hop from http-> canonical https (and www/non-www per prior S-002). Confirm via curl -I on all 4 scheme/host variants. Request re-indexing of the canonical URL once fixed.
'Unassigned' channel reports 49 conversions with 1.25% engagement rate

Current 28d: Unassigned = 80 sessions, engagementRate 0.0125, conversions 49 — the single largest conversion count of any channel despite near-zero real engagement. Likely server-side/webhook events (GHL form, RoofQuotePro) firing without session context.

Audit GA4 Admin > Events > Key events: confirm which events are marked conversions. Add proper client_id/UTM context to server-side webhook calls so they attribute to the correct channel instead of 'Unassigned'. Re-baseline true lead count using roofquotepro_lead_submitted (2) + ghl_form (11) + phone_click (3), not the raw 'conversions' total.
book-appointment and contact (highest-value conversion pages) have chronic worst-in-site LCP

Tech-audit log shows /book-appointment and /contact recorded LCP up to 9,000-16,000ms and performance scores in the 20s-40s repeatedly between June-August; still open findings P-325/P-326 (book-appointment CLS/score) as of 2026-08-28.
Prioritize LCP fix on these two templates first — profile hero/image loading and any synchronous RoofQuotePro/GHL widget script blocking render. Re-test with PageSpeed after fix.
~50 open Performance findings (LCP/score) spanning nearly every template, most 60-81 days stale

findings.md: homepage, all /services/*, all /service-areas/*, most /blog/* posts flagged 'LCP above threshold' or 'Performance score below target', many first-seen 2026-06-08/06-24/07-21 and still open.

Root-cause once at the template level rather than per-page: check next/image priority/sizes usage for cdn.sanity.io hero images, and defer/lazy-load third-party scripts (RoofQuotePro, GHL, chat) below the fold. Re-run the audit sweep after the fix to confirm the whole backlog clears together.
Non-brand commercial queries rank but essentially don't convert to clicks

'roof repair frederick md': 600 impr, pos 15.1, 2 clicks (0.33% CTR). 'roofing companies frederick md': 230 impr, pos 22.8, 2 clicks. Brand queries ('shumaker roofing') carry the click volume (20 of ~98 clicks) instead.
Rewrite title tags/meta descriptions for these commercial-intent pages to be more compelling at their current position; add schema/rich-result eligibility where missing; track CTR weekly post-change.
/blog listing page nearly invisible in search
3,941 impressions, avg position 37.9, only 1 click over 28 days — underperforming for what should be a strong internal hub page.

Add stronger internal linking into /blog from high-authority pages (homepage, service pages), ensure it has unique optimized title/meta, and confirm it isn't excluded by a noindex or thin-content issue.
/blog/when-to-get-roof-rejuvenation-frederick-md: pos 6.3, 35 impr, 0 clicks. /blog/how-much-do-new-gutters-cost-maryland: pos 9.8, 141 impr, 0 clicks. Good rank, snippet isn't earning the click.
Rewrite title + meta description to include price/benefit hooks and a clear CTA; add FAQ schema where applicable to win more SERP real estate.
'what-is-roof-rejuvenation' has high demand but very poor rank
1,720 impressions but average position 54.9 — likely cannibalized by sibling 'rejuvenation' posts (historically flagged S-063/064/065 in the tech-audit log).
Consolidate or differentiate the rejuvenation content cluster: pick one primary target page for the head term, cross-link supporting posts to it, and de-duplicate overlapping title/meta targeting.
Legacy WordPress URLs still receiving impressions post-Sanity-migration

/asphalt-shingles-vs-metal-roofing-which-is-better-for-you/, /best-flat-roof-coating-in-frederick-md/, /author/tyler/page/3/ and /6/, /blog//what-is-roof-rejuvenation (double slash) all show impressions with no clean redirect to current content.
301-redirect each legacy URL to its current Sanity-CMS equivalent; fix the double-slash URL generation bug if reproducible in lib/utils.ts or blog link construction.
Live blog page missing from sitemap.xml (H-049)
/blog/replacing-gutters-with-new-roof-frederick-md is live but absent from sitemap.xml as of 2026-08-28 — reduces crawl priority for a published page.
Confirm app/sitemap.ts includes all published Sanity blog documents; add the missing entry and verify revalidate is still set (root cause of a prior identical bug, H-039).
Desktop CTR underperforms mobile despite far more impressions
Desktop: 37,525 impressions, 0.19% CTR. Mobile: 6,268 impressions, 0.45% CTR (2.4x higher) despite worse average position (28.5 vs 16.4).

Investigate desktop-specific rendering/speed issues (heavier hero assets, no responsive srcset) that may be suppressing desktop SERP appeal; confirm desktop LCP separately from mobile in PageSpeed sweep.
H-047, H-048, H-050, H-051 and others: services and blog documents missing hero/og images, degrading social-share previews and og:image-based rich results.
Backfill missing images in Sanity for the affected service/blog documents; add a required-field validation in the schema to prevent future publishes without a featured image.
Real lead-intent event volume is much lower than the 'conversions' metric suggests
Current 28d event counts: book_appointment=34 (click, not necessarily completion), ghl_form=11, roofquotepro_lead_submitted=2, phone_click=3 — versus ~93 summed 'conversions' across channels.

Use this table as the honest lead baseline until the Key Events audit (see Critical row above) is completed; report actual submitted-lead count, not raw GA4 conversions, to stakeholders in the interim.
